intro.text: A nation of Darkside, home of the Elisians.
An independent kingdom on Darkside, whose people are known as Elisians.

description.text: Elisians are dark-haired and dark-eyed, with deep brown skin, and they like cinnamon in their tea.
Lonzare's Darksider community is very mixed, yet it seems to include no Elisians.
Elis is on poor terms with the Dynasty. Its Prince Gevalden went to Dayside hoping to win the sand masters over as a weapon against the empire.
